export const meta = {
  name: 'legal-ui-design-panel',
  description: 'Three UX proposals for a German-speaking legal team, judged and ranked',
  phases: [
    { title: 'Propose', detail: '3 independent UX concepts from different lenses' },
    { title: 'Judge', detail: '2 judges score all proposals and pick grafts' },
  ],
}

const CONTEXT = `
You are redesigning the user-facing layer of an existing, working web app: "Contract Intelligence", a contract-review
tool for Riverty's legal team. Repo: /Users/gaurav/Downloads/riverty_challenge. Read README.md (concept), web/src/api.ts
(the FIXED backend contract: types + endpoints), web/src/pages/*.tsx and web/src/App.tsx (current UI, MUI 9), and look at
the current screenshots in web/e2e/screenshots/*.png (use the Read tool on the PNGs).

Users: a mostly German-speaking legal team (lawyers, paralegals), NOT engineers. The tool must be:
  - German by default, English switchable (both complete).
  - Simple and pleasant ("fun") to use: task-oriented, plain language, warm and friendly microcopy, clear
    traffic-light style verdicts, good empty states, visible progress. Professional, not childish.
  - Technical substance must be KEPT but de-emphasised: confidence percentages, method traces
    (rules/embedding/verifier), model names, OCR methods, SHA-256, evaluation metrics, model routing must move into
    small print / collapsed "Details" / a global "show technical details" switch (off by default) / a low-key
    "Technik" area of the navigation. Nothing technical should be the first thing a lawyer sees.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: keep every existing capability (ingest/upload, coverage matrix, three audit kinds, review with
approve/reject/push to contract storage, audit log, ask with citations, evaluation, model routing). Do not invent
backend features; the API in web/src/api.ts is fixed (the only planned backend addition: audits and chat may carry a
'language' so model-written reasoning comes back in German or English). Use MUI 9 components. No new npm packages
except possibly none — a hand-rolled 60-line i18n hook is preferred over a library.
Return ONLY the structured proposal.`

const PROPOSAL = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    lens: { type: 'string' },
    one_paragraph_pitch: { type: 'string' },
    navigation: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: { id: { type: 'string' }, de: { type: 'string' }, en: { type: 'string' }, purpose: { type: 'string' }, technical_area: { type: 'boolean' } }, required: ['id', 'de', 'en', 'purpose', 'technical_area'] } },
    start_page: { type: 'string', description: 'What the landing page shows and why' },
    pages: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: { id: { type: 'string' }, headline_de: { type: 'string' }, headline_en: { type: 'string' }, primary_content: { type: 'string' }, hidden_technical_details: { type: 'string' }, friendly_touches: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['id', 'headline_de', 'headline_en', 'primary_content', 'hidden_technical_details', 'friendly_touches'] } },
    vocabulary: { type: 'array', description: 'Plain-language DE/EN terms for every concept the UI shows: audit kinds, verdicts (confirmed/unverified/unreadable/dismissed), review statuses, clause types (12), input types, methods', items: { type: 'object', properties: { concept: { type: 'string' }, de: { type: 'string' }, en: { type: 'string' }, note: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['concept', 'de', 'en'] } },
    technical_toggle: { type: 'string', description: 'Exactly what the global technical-details switch reveals, where it lives, default state' },
    fun_without_being_silly: { type: 'string' },
    risks: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
  },
  required: ['lens', 'one_paragraph_pitch', 'navigation', 'start_page', 'pages', 'vocabulary', 'technical_toggle', 'fun_without_being_silly', 'risks'],
}

const LENSES = [
  { key: 'lawyer-first', prompt: 'Lens: a senior in-house lawyer who hates software. Optimise for zero training: the three questions the team actually asks must be reachable in one click with words a lawyer uses (Klausel, Vertrag, Prüfung, Freigabe). Everything else recedes.' },
  { key: 'task-flow', prompt: 'Lens: a product designer who thinks in flows. Design the app as guided tasks (choose question → see result → decide → file), with progress feedback and satisfying completion states, while still exposing the tables for power users.' },
  { key: 'trust-and-calm', prompt: 'Lens: a UX writer focused on trust for sensitive legal documents. Optimise the wording of verdicts, confidence, "unreadable", "needs verification", human sign-off and the audit trail so a lawyer feels in control and never misled — in German legal register (Sie-Form) and in English.' },
]

phase('Propose')
const proposals = (await parallel(LENSES.map((l) => () =>
  agent(`${CONTEXT}\n\n${l.prompt}`, { label: `propose:${l.key}`, phase: 'Propose', schema: PROPOSAL })
))).filter(Boolean)

230	- thinking level: minimal / low / medium / high: DE «Denkaufwand: minimal / gering / mittel / hoch» / EN «Effort: minimal / low / medium / high»
231	- routing task: ocr_vision: DE «Scans und Handschrift lesen» / EN «Read scans and handwriting»
232	- routing task: classify: DE «Klauseln einordnen» / EN «Label clauses»
233	- routing task: extract: DE «Parteien und Vertragsart erkennen» / EN «Extract parties and contract type»
234	- routing task: screen: DE «Auf verdächtigen Text prüfen» / EN «Screen for suspicious text»
235	- routing task: verify: DE «Funde gegenprüfen» / EN «Cross-check findings»
236	- routing task: answer: DE «Fragen beantworten» / EN «Answer questions»
237	- routing: embeddings: DE «Ähnlichkeitssuche» / EN «Similarity search»
238	- contract type: merchant_agreement: DE «Händlervertrag» / EN «Merchant agreement»
239	- contract type: dpa: DE «Auftragsverarbeitungsvertrag (AVV)» / EN «Data processing agreement (DPA)»
240	- contract type: nda: DE «Geheimhaltungsvereinbarung (NDA)» / EN «Non-disclosure agreement (NDA)»
241	- contract type: vendor_agreement: DE «Lieferantenvertrag» / EN «Vendor agreement»
242	- contract type: receivables_purchase: DE «Forderungskaufvertrag» / EN «Receivables purchase agreement»
243	- contract type: collection_services: DE «Inkassodienstleistungsvertrag» / EN «Collection services agreement»
244	- contract type: saas_agreement: DE «SaaS-Vertrag» / EN «SaaS agreement»
245	- contract type: amendment: DE «Nachtrag» / EN «Amendment»
246	- contract type: other: DE «Sonstiger Vertrag» / EN «Other»
247	- scope filter: all types: DE «Alle Vertragsarten» / EN «All contract types»
248	- language switch: DE «DE | EN» / EN «DE | EN» — Tooltip: 'Bedienoberfläche und KI-Texte (Antworten, Gegenprüfung) in dieser Sprache.'
249	- technical switch: DE «Technische Details anzeigen» / EN «Show technical details»
250	- nav group: DE «Technik» / EN «Technical»
251	
252	# Vocabulary A
253	
254	- audit kind: missing_clause: DE «Fehlende Klausel — Frage: „Welchen Verträgen fehlt eine Klausel?“» / EN «Missing clause — question: “Which contracts lack a clause?”»
255	- audit kind: missing_passage: DE «Fehlende Passage — Frage: „Welche Verträge enthalten diese Passage nicht?“» / EN «Missing passage — question: “Which contracts do not contain this passage?”»
256	- audit kind: rename: DE «Alter Firmenname — Frage: „Welche Verträge nennen noch den alten Firmennamen?“» / EN «Old company name — question: “Which contracts still name the old company?”»
257	- verdict: confirmed: DE «Bestätigt – Handlungsbedarf» / EN «Confirmed – action needed» — Red filled chip. The verifier read the whole contract and agrees.
258	- verdict: unverified: DE «Vorläufig – bitte selbst prüfen» / EN «Preliminary – please check» — Amber filled chip. Found by the rule layer; no AI cross-check available (offline). The common case in offline mode, so the copy must not sound like an alarm.
259	- verdict: unreadable: DE «Nicht lesbar – bitte Original ansehen» / EN «Unreadable – please see the original» — Grey-blue chip. Low OCR quality; explicitly not scored as fine.
260	- verdict: dismissed: DE «Entwarnung» / EN «Cleared» — Grey outlined chip. The AI cross-check rejected the preliminary finding. Wording to be validated with the legal team.
261	- summary state: present: DE «In Ordnung» / EN «Fine» — Green tile.
262	- summary state: missing (flagged): DE «Handlungsbedarf» / EN «Needs attention» — Red tile; per kind the sentence is 'brauchen den neuen Namen' / 'fehlt die Klausel' / 'enthalten die Passage nicht'.
263	- summary state: uncertain: DE «Unsicher – bitte ansehen» / EN «Uncertain – please look» — Amber tile.
264	- summary state: historical_only: DE «Nur historischer Hinweis (z. B. „Riverty, vormals Arvato“)» / EN «Historical reference only (e.g. “Riverty, formerly Arvato”)» — Counted with 'In Ordnung' but named in the summary sentence.
265	- summary state: unreadable: DE «Nicht lesbar» / EN «Unreadable»
266	- summary: verified true / false: DE «Von der KI gegengeprüft / Noch nicht gegengeprüft» / EN «Cross-checked by the AI / Not yet cross-checked» — Model name appended only with technical details on.
267	- confidence (0.8+ / 0.5–0.8 / below): DE «Sicherheit: hoch / mittel / niedrig» / EN «Certainty: high / medium / low» — Coloured dot; the percentage appears next to the word only with technical details on.
268	- review status: pending: DE «Wartet auf Freigabe» / EN «Awaiting decision» — Amber outlined chip.
269	- review status: approved: DE «Freigegeben» / EN «Approved» — Green outlined chip.
270	- review status: rejected: DE «Abgelehnt» / EN «Rejected» — Grey outlined chip.
271	- storage_ref present: DE «Abgelegt · CS-XXXX» / EN «Filed · CS-XXXX» — Green chip with the reference number kept visible.
272	- action: review approve / reject: DE «Freigeben / Ablehnen» / EN «Approve / Reject»
273	- action: push to storage: DE «In Vertragsablage ablegen» / EN «File in contract storage» — Tooltip: 'Mehrfaches Ablegen erzeugt keine zweite Kopie.'
274	- action: run audit: DE «Prüfung starten» / EN «Start check»
275	- clause: term_termination: DE «Laufzeit und Kündigung (kurz: Laufzeit)» / EN «Term and termination»
276	- clause: fees_payment: DE «Vergütung und Zahlung (kurz: Vergütung)» / EN «Fees and payment»
277	- clause: liability_cap: DE «Haftungsbegrenzung» / EN «Limitation of liability»

# Proposal A (lawyer-first) — pages

## start — Was möchten Sie wissen? / What would you like to know?
Three question cards (missing clause with clause dropdown; missing passage with text field; old company name with registry hint), each with a 'Prüfen' button that creates the audit and jumps to its result. 'Wartet auf Ihre Freigabe' card with pending count and button. 'Ihr Vertragsbestand' strip with counts, ingest progress bar, and 'Verträge hinzufügen'. 'Letzte Prüfungen' list of the three most recent audits as plain sentences with status chips. Empty state that routes to upload / sample set.

HIDDEN: Nothing technical by default. With the switch on: a small footer line 'KI-Gegenprüfung: verbunden (gemini-3.1-pro-preview)' or 'nicht verbunden (kein GEMINI_API_KEY)', and '#id' prefixes on the recent-checks list.

FRIENDLY: Time-of-day greeting; the cards repeat the lawyer's exact question; 'Alles erledigt.' with a check icon when nothing is pending; progress copy 'Wir lesen gerade 3 von 14 Verträgen…'; the question cards remember the last clause chosen (localStorage).

## contracts — Verträge / Contracts
Toolbar: 'Verträge hochladen (PDF, JPG, PNG)' as the primary button (multi-file, plus a drag-and-drop zone that appears while dragging) and 'Beispielverträge laden' as a secondary button. While documents are queued/processing, a banner 'Wir lesen gerade 3 von 14 Verträgen…' with a LinearProgress (polling stays as is). Table: Vertrag (title, filename in small grey), Vertragsart (German names), Sprache (Deutsch/Englisch), Lesbarkeit (traffic-light pill computed from the lowest page confidence: 'Gut lesbar' green, 'Teilweise schwer lesbar' amber, 'Nicht lesbar' red, 'Wird gelesen…' while processing), Hinweis (warning icon 'Versteckte Anweisungen' when injection_suspected), Status ('Bereit', 'Wird gelesen', 'Fehlgeschlagen'). Row click opens 'Vertrag ansehen' dialog with tabs Klauseln (Nr, Überschrift, Klauseltyp in German, Seite; row shows the clause text on expand), Beteiligte (Name, Rolle: 'Unser Unternehmen – alter Name' red / 'Unser Unternehmen – aktuell' green / 'Vertragspartner' grey, 'historischer Hinweis' tag, Seite, Kontext), Text (per-page text with 'Seite n' headers). The dialog accepts an initial page/clause so findings and answers can deep-link into it (route query ?vertrag=ID&seite=N).

HIDDEN: Removed from default view: the per-page extraction chips (text layer / tesseract / vision + %), Klauseln/Beteiligte count columns, the routing sentence ('Every page is routed…'), sha256 in the dialog subtitle, clause confidence bars and the 'How' column (rules / llm+rules agree / llm (rules disagree), rule_label, llm_label), entity method and fuzzy ratio, page method chips in the Text tab. With the switch on they all return in place; additionally the dialog gets a collapsed 'Technische Details' accordion at the bottom (sha256 full, raw input_type, ingest_summary table with method/confidence/note, injection_note raw).

FRIENDLY: Lesbarkeit pill instead of OCR jargon; injection warning in plain words: 'Dieses Dokument enthält versteckte Anweisungen an KI-Systeme. Es wird nur als Text behandelt – bitte trotzdem mit Vorsicht lesen.'; failed documents say 'Konnte nicht gelesen werden' with the error under a Details link; snackbar 'Wir lesen jetzt 3 Verträge…' after upload; empty state identical to Start.

## clauses — Klausel-Übersicht / Clause overview
Subtitle 'Welcher Vertrag enthält welche Klausel?'. A legend row: '✓ enthalten · ? wahrscheinlich, bitte prüfen · – nicht gefunden'. Matrix with sticky first column (Vertrag: title, Vertragsart · Sprache) and 12 sticky column headers with short German clause names (full name in tooltip). Cells: green check for present with confidence ≥ 0.8, green check with a small '?' for 0.5–0.8, a light grey dash for not found (no red flood: absence is normal, the check is what flags it). Each column header shows 'fehlt in n' and has a menu 'Diese Klausel prüfen' that creates the missing_clause audit for that column (and the active Vertragsart filter) and jumps to the result. Cell click opens the contract dialog on that clause. Filter: Vertragsart select.

HIDDEN: The 'absence is a fact of the matrix, not an inference' blurb is replaced by one plain sentence ('Die Übersicht entsteht beim Einlesen jedes Vertrags. Ein Strich heißt: Wir haben keine solche Klausel gefunden.'). Cell tooltip shows heading and page only; with the switch on it adds '78 % via llm+rules agree', the opacity-by-confidence shading returns, and the raw taxonomy keys appear under the German headers.

FRIENDLY: Row hover highlights the whole row; the count 'fehlt in 5' turns a column into a one-click check; empty state links to Verträge; the header uses the same German clause names as the check dropdown so the two views feel like one thing.

## checks — Prüfungen / Checks
Top card 'Neue Prüfung': a three-option ToggleButtonGroup with the lawyer questions (icons: missing piece, quote, name tag); beneath it only the one field that question needs (Klausel select / Passage textarea / optional 'Alter Name' with registry helper text); 'Eingrenzen auf Vertragsart' as an optional select; primary button 'Prüfung starten'. Left column 'Bisherige Prüfungen': list with plain titles ('Fehlende Klausel: Haftungsbegrenzung · Händlerverträge', 'Alter Firmenname · alle Verträge'), date, status chip ('Läuft…', 'Abgeschlossen', 'Fehlgeschlagen'). Right column: the selected check. Running: card with indeterminate progress 'Wir lesen 14 Verträge… das dauert meist unter einer Minute.' Done: one summary sentence ('14 Verträge geprüft: 8 brauchen den neuen Namen, 4 sind in Ordnung, 1 nennt den alten Namen nur als Hinweis auf die Umfirmierung, 1 konnte nicht gelesen werden.'), then four traffic-light tiles (Handlungsbedarf / Bitte ansehen / In Ordnung / Nicht lesbar) built from summary.missing, uncertain, present + historical_only, unreadable, plus a chip 'Von der KI gegengeprüft' or 'Noch nicht gegengeprüft'. Results table: Vertrag | Ergebnis (verdict chip + one-line statement templated client-side from audit_kind and params: 'Klausel „Haftungsbegrenzung“ fehlt', 'Passage fehlt: „Each Party shall comply…“', 'Alter Firmenname wird noch als Vertragspartei verwendet') | Beleg (Seite n: quote, truncated) | Freigabe (review status chip). Row expand: full quotes with 'Vertrag öffnen' (deep link to the contract dialog at that page), 'Begründung' (verifier reasoning, in the UI language once the language param is passed), 'Freigeben' / 'Ablehnen' buttons reusing the approvals dialog so a lawyer can decide right here, and a collapsed accordion 'Wie kam das System darauf?'. Failed: 'Die Prüfung ist fehlgeschlagen.' with the error under Details.

HIDDEN: Confidence % replaced by 'Sicherheit: hoch / mittel / niedrig' with a small coloured dot (thresholds 0.8 / 0.5, same as the existing bar colours). The method chain (raw backend strings such as 'coverage matrix: 0 of 14 clauses labelled liability_cap', 'nearest clause by embedding…', 'entity registry: 2 active mention(s)…', 'OCR-tolerant fuzzy match…', 'verifier gemini-3.1-pro-preview: confirmed (92%)') lives inside 'Wie kam das System darauf?'. With the switch off, that accordion shows a plain one-liner derived from the first chain step's prefix ('Über die Klausel-Übersicht gefunden' / 'Über die Ähnlichkeitssuche gefunden' / 'Über das Firmen-Register gefunden'), a second line 'Noch nicht von der KI gegengeprüft' or 'Von der KI gegengeprüft', and a link 'Technische Details einblenden'. With the switch on: the raw chain as the numbered MethodTrace, the percentage next to the word, the model name in the verified chip ('verified by gemini-3.1-pro-preview'), the audit '#id', raw params chips, and thresholds text.

FRIENDLY: Summary sentence before any numbers; 'Nichts gefunden – alle 14 Verträge sind in Ordnung.' with a check icon; per-kind icons; the passage question shows the lawyer's own text back in the title; a 'Zur Freigabe (8 offen)' link at the top of results when findings are pending; list titles never show raw keys.

## approvals — Freigabe / Approvals
Subtitle 'Nichts verlässt das System ohne Ihre Entscheidung.' Tabs: 'Offen (8)', 'Entschieden (3)', 'Protokoll'. Offen: one card per pending finding, in this order: contract title and Vertragsart, the plain finding sentence (same template as Prüfungen), verdict chip, then the quoted evidence block(s) ('Seite 3: „…“') with 'Vertrag öffnen', then 'Begründung' (verifier reasoning) when present, then buttons 'Freigeben' (contained, green) and 'Ablehnen' (outlined). Optional filter chips by check type. The decision dialog is titled 'Fund freigeben' / 'Fund ablehnen', has 'Anmerkung (optional)' and 'Bestätigen'; Enter confirms. Entschieden: table Vertrag | Fund | Entscheidung | Anmerkung | Vertragsablage, where approved findings without storage_ref show 'In Vertragsablage ablegen' and after the push a green chip 'Abgelegt · CS-XXXX' (the reference is a lawyer-relevant number and stays visible). Protokoll: rows 'Datum · Wer · Was · Wobei' with plain action names (Vertrag eingelesen / Prüfung gestartet / Fund freigegeben / Fund abgelehnt / In Vertragsablage abgelegt) and the target resolved to a contract or check title where the details allow, else 'Fund #12'.

HIDDEN: Confidence bar replaced by the word form; MethodTrace moves into the same collapsed 'Wie kam das System darauf?' accordion as on Prüfungen; the idempotency sentence becomes a tooltip on the storage button ('Mehrfaches Ablegen erzeugt keine zweite Kopie.'); the Protokoll's JSON details column is hidden and the action shows its plain name. With the switch on: raw action keys (finding.pushed_to_storage), target_type #id, the monospace JSON details column, idempotency_key, sha256 in ingest rows, and percentages return.

FRIENDLY: Empty state 'Alles erledigt. Nichts wartet auf Ihre Freigabe.' with a check icon; snackbar after approval 'Freigegeben. Jetzt in der Vertragsablage ablegen?' with an inline action button; nav badge count updates immediately; the card order puts the quote where a lawyer's eye lands first; rejected findings show the note in the table so colleagues see why.

## ask — Fragen Sie Ihre Verträge / Ask your contracts
One large text field with placeholder 'Zum Beispiel: Welche Kündigungsfrist gilt im Inkassovertrag mit Rheinland Energie?' and a 'Fragen' button; three example chips in the UI language (the existing three, with German versions). The language toggle's value is sent as chat language. Loading copy 'Wir suchen in 14 Verträgen…'. Answer card: answer text, then 'Belegstellen' as quote cards (contract title, 'Seite n', quote, 'Vertrag öffnen' deep link). Below, a collapsed accordion 'Weitere gefundene Stellen (8)' listing the retrieved passages with contract title, German clause type, page and quote.

HIDDEN: The 'Hybrid retrieval (full-text + vector, fused)' blurb is removed; passage scores and [index] numbers hidden; the mode chip becomes a soft info line only when offline ('Ohne KI-Verbindung zeigen wir die passendsten Stellen statt einer Antwort.'). With the switch on: chip 'Gemini, cited' / 'offline: extractive', scores and indices on passages, and a one-line retrieval note.

FRIENDLY: The answer comes back in the language of the UI; 'Wir haben dazu nichts in den Verträgen gefunden.' when no passages; example chips are real questions from the sample corpus in both languages; pressing Enter asks.

## tech-evaluation — Qualitätsmessung / Quality measurement
Subtitle 'Wie zuverlässig ist das System? Gemessen an 14 Beispielverträgen, deren Inhalt wir genau kennen.' Button 'Messung starten'. Results: two cards phrased plainly first ('Fehlende Klauseln erkennen: 41 von 41 gefunden, 7 Fehlalarme', 'Alten Firmennamen erkennen: 8 von 8 gefunden, 0 Fehlalarme') with the three metrics beneath, labelled 'Genauigkeit (Precision) · Trefferquote (Recall) · F1'. Table of finished checks with the same plain titles as Prüfungen plus Gegengeprüft ja/nein and the three metrics. Collapsed sections 'Texterkennung nach Dokumenttyp' (German input types, pages, methods in plain words, average readability) and 'Schutz vor versteckten Anweisungen' (C13 erwartet: Angriff → erkannt · richtig). Unreadable documents listed as 'Als nicht lesbar an einen Menschen übergeben: C14'.

HIDDEN: This page sits in the Technik group, so metrics are visible here regardless of the switch. The switch additionally reveals TP/FP/FN counts, raw error keys ('C07:data_protection (false positive)' instead of 'C07 · Datenschutz · Fehlalarm'), raw method names and the llm_enabled flag.

FRIENDLY: Sentences before numbers; empty state 'Noch keine Messung. Starten Sie eine – sie dauert etwa eine halbe Minute.'; error lists map contract codes to titles where the documents list allows.

## tech-models — Modelle und Verarbeitung / Models and processing
Intro line 'Welches KI-Modell welche Aufgabe übernimmt – und was ohne KI weiterläuft.' Status banner: 'KI verbunden – alle Schritte aktiv.' (green) or 'Keine KI-Verbindung – nur die regelbasierte Grundlage läuft. Funde werden als vorläufig markiert.' (amber). Table Aufgabe (German task names: Handschrift und Scans lesen, Klauseln zuordnen, Vertragsdaten auslesen, Versteckte Anweisungen erkennen, Funde gegenprüfen, Fragen beantworten, Ähnlichkeitssuche) | Modell (monospace) | Denkaufwand (minimal/niedrig/mittel/hoch chips) | Zweck (client-side German text keyed by task, falling back to the API's English purpose).

HIDDEN: None hidden here; it is the Technik area. The switch has no effect on this page beyond the app-wide footer line.

FRIENDLY: Plain task names in the first column so a lawyer who wanders in still understands the rows; the banner tells them what 'vorläufig' on the other pages means.


# Proposal C (trust writing) — pages

## home — Überblick / Overview
Greeting line with the pending-decision count and 'Zur Freigabe' button; three question cards that open Prüfungen with the kind preselected; status strip '14 Verträge · 13 gut lesbar · 1 nicht lesbar'; 'Zuletzt geprüft' with the last three checks as one-sentence summaries and their traffic-light counts; empty state with 'Verträge hochladen' and 'Beispielpaket laden'.

HIDDEN: Nothing technical is shown here even with the switch on, except that the connection line names the model ('Gegenprüfung: gemini-3.1-pro-preview') when the switch is on.

FRIENDLY: Time-of-day greeting (Guten Morgen / Guten Tag / Guten Abend); 'Nichts wartet auf Sie.' as the empty queue line; relative times ('vor 12 Minuten') with absolute timestamp on hover; a running check shows a slim progress bar in its card with 'Läuft – meist unter einer Minute.'

## documents — Verträge / Contracts
Buttons: 'Verträge hochladen (PDF, JPG, PNG)' and 'Beispielpaket laden'; a drop zone ('PDF oder Foto hierher ziehen') above the table. Table columns: Vertrag (title, filename in small grey), Vertragsart (translated), Sprache, Quelle (Digitales PDF / Scan / PDF mit gescannten Seiten / Foto / Handschrift), Lesbarkeit (traffic light derived from ingest_summary: 'Gut lesbar' ≥ 80 %, 'Schwer lesbar' 50–79 %, 'Nicht lesbar' < 50 % — with an eye icon and the sentence 'Nicht lesbar = wird in Prüfungen als ungeprüft ausgewiesen'), Status (Wartet / Wird gelesen… / Bereit / Fehlgeschlagen). A shield icon marks 'Verdächtiger Text im Dokument'. Row click opens the contract: title, contract type, language, pages, 'Prüfsumme 6b52e1ca…' in small print with tooltip 'Eindeutiger Fingerabdruck der Datei; ändert sich die Datei, ändert sich die Prüfsumme'; the injection alert in plain words: 'Dieses Dokument enthält Text, der sich an automatische Prüfsysteme richtet (z. B. „bereits von der Rechtsabteilung freigegeben“). Solche Anweisungen werden ignoriert. Bitte prüfen Sie dieses Dokument mit besonderer Sorgfalt.' Tabs: Klauseln (Nr., Überschrift, Art, Verlässlichkeit as word, Seite), Genannte Unternehmen (Name, Rolle: Alter Riverty-Name / Aktueller Riverty-Name / Vertragspartner / Anderes Unternehmen, 'nur historischer Verweis' badge, Seite, Kontext), Seitentext (per page with a legibility word).

HIDDEN: Per-page extraction chips (text layer / tesseract / vision_llm with %), clause and entity counts in the list, confidence percentages, classification method (rules / llm+rules agree / llm (rules disagree)) with rule_label and llm_label, entity match method (exact / OCR-tolerant fuzzy with ratio / LLM) — all only with the switch on. Full SHA-256 and the raw error string of a failed document in a 'Details' collapse. The injection pattern quote sits under 'Details' inside the alert.

FRIENDLY: Progress line while reading: '3 von 14 Verträgen gelesen …' from status counts; completion line 'Alle 14 Verträge sind bereit.'; the sample button says what it contains: 'Beispielpaket laden (14 Verträge, darunter Scans und eine Handschrift)'; empty state: 'Noch keine Verträge. Laden Sie Verträge hoch oder starten Sie mit dem Beispielpaket.'

## coverage — Klausel-Übersicht / Clause overview
One-sentence intro: 'Für jeden Vertrag sehen Sie, welche der zwölf Standardklauseln gefunden wurden. Klicken Sie auf eine Spalte, um zu prüfen, welche Verträge diese Klausel nicht enthalten.' Filter by contract type. Matrix with translated clause names in the header (wrapped, not rotated, with short forms like 'Haftung' + tooltip); three cell states with icon and colour: green check 'vorhanden', amber ring 'vorhanden, unsicher' (< 80 %), grey dash 'nicht gefunden' (absence is neutral grey, not red — an NDA legitimately lacks most clauses). Hover: 'Haftungsbegrenzung · „Limitation of Liability“ · Seite 2'. Legend below the table. Column-header click deep-links to Prüfungen with kind=missing_clause and the clause preselected.

HIDDEN: Percentage and classification method in the cell tooltip; cell opacity as continuous confidence shading; the sentence about absence being a matrix lookup rather than an inference moves into an info popover ('Wie entsteht diese Übersicht?').

FRIENDLY: Row count and 'alle sichtbar' feedback after filtering; keyboard focusable cells with the same text as the tooltip for screen readers; empty state: 'Die Übersicht füllt sich, sobald Verträge gelesen sind.'

## audits — Prüfungen / Checks
Left column 'Neue Prüfung': the three questions as selectable cards (not a dropdown), then one parameter field: clause type (translated names), passage text ('Beschreiben Sie die Regelung in eigenen Worten – der Wortlaut muss nicht übereinstimmen.'), or old name ('Leer lassen = alle bekannten alten Namen: arvato Financial Solutions, Arvato Payment Solutions GmbH, AFS'), scope 'Vertragsart: alle', button 'Prüfung starten'. Below it the list of previous checks as sentences ('Alter Firmenname · alle Vertragsarten · 8 auffällig · Abgeschlossen'). Right column: result header as one plain sentence generated from the summary — '8 von 14 Verträgen nennen noch den alten Firmennamen. 1 Vertrag konnte nicht gelesen werden und gilt nicht als geprüft.' — followed by count chips 'unauffällig · auffällig · unklar · nur historischer Verweis · nicht lesbar' and the cross-check badge ('KI-gegengeprüft' green / 'Ohne KI-Gegenprüfung' amber). Results table: Vertrag, Ergebnis (verdict chip), Verlässlichkeit (word), Beleg (first quote, 'Seite 3'), Entscheidung (review status), and a 'Zur Freigabe' link for open ones. Row expands to: the finding in plain words built from kind + params ('Keine Klausel „Haftungsbegrenzung“ gefunden'), evidence quotes with the honest sub-label ('Fundstelle des alten Namens' for rename, 'Ähnlichste Stelle – ersetzt die gesuchte Klausel nicht' for missing-clause/passage, 'Entscheidende Stelle laut Gegenprüfung' when the verifier supplied the quote), the cross-check paragraph labelled 'KI-Gegenprüfung im Volltext:', and a collapsed 'Details: So kam der Fund zustande'.

HIDDEN: With the switch off, 'So kam der Fund zustande' shows a one-line plain summary derived from known method_chain prefixes ('Regelprüfung (Klausel-Übersicht) → Ähnlichkeitssuche → Gegenprüfung nicht verfügbar'); with it on, the raw numbered method_chain steps, similarity values and thresholds, the verifier model name and its percentage, OCR percentages and the 50 %/80 % gates, the audit id, the params as raw chips. The unreadable row's explanation 'OCR-Konfidenz 34 % unter der 50 %-Grenze; Bildmodell offline nicht verfügbar' is only visible with the switch on; without it the row says 'Seiten 1–2 konnten nicht zuverlässig gelesen werden. Dieser Vertrag wurde nicht geprüft. Bitte prüfen Sie das Original.'

FRIENDLY: Running state: indeterminate bar with '14 Verträge werden gelesen – das dauert meist unter einer Minute.'; all-clear state stays precise: 'Kein Vertrag im Prüfumfang ist auffällig.' plus, if applicable, 'Ein Vertrag konnte nicht gelesen werden und ist hier nicht enthalten.'; the passage field shows an example in the chosen language; the card of the selected question carries its parameter so the form reads like a sentence.

## review — Freigabe / Sign-off

import { useState } from 'react'
import { BrowserRouter, Navigate, NavLink, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom'
import AppBar from '@mui/material/AppBar'
import Badge from '@mui/material/Badge'
import Box from '@mui/material/Box'
import Chip from '@mui/material/Chip'
import Collapse from '@mui/material/Collapse'
import CssBaseline from '@mui/material/CssBaseline'
import Drawer from '@mui/material/Drawer'
import FormControlLabel from '@mui/material/FormControlLabel'
import List from '@mui/material/List'
import ListItemButton from '@mui/material/ListItemButton'
import ListItemIcon from '@mui/material/ListItemIcon'
import ListItemText from '@mui/material/ListItemText'
import Switch from '@mui/material/Switch'
import ToggleButton from '@mui/material/ToggleButton'
import ToggleButtonGroup from '@mui/material/ToggleButtonGroup'
import Toolbar from '@mui/material/Toolbar'
import Tooltip from '@mui/material/Tooltip'
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography'
import { ThemeProvider, createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles'
import HomeIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Home'
import DescriptionIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Description'
import GridOnIcon from '@mui/icons-material/GridOn'
import FactCheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/FactCheck'
import HowToRegIcon from '@mui/icons-material/HowToReg'
import QuestionAnswerIcon from '@mui/icons-material/QuestionAnswer'
import AssessmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Assessment'
import MemoryIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Memory'
import ExpandMoreIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ExpandMore'
import ExpandLessIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ExpandLess'
import GavelIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Gavel'
import { api } from './api'
import { SettingsProvider, useSettings, useT, type Lang } from './i18n'
import { ToastProvider, usePolling } from './components/ui'
import { COMMON } from './vocab'
import Home from './pages/Home'
import Contracts from './pages/Contracts'
import Clauses from './pages/Clauses'
import Checks from './pages/Checks'
import Approvals from './pages/Approvals'
import Ask from './pages/Ask'
import Quality from './pages/Quality'
import Models from './pages/Models'

const theme = createTheme({
  palette: {
    primary: { main: '#00695c' },
    secondary: { main: '#6a1b9a' },
    background: { default: '#f4f6f6' },
  },
  shape: { borderRadius: 10 },
  typography: { h5: { fontWeight: 600 }, h6: { fontWeight: 600 } },
  components: {
    MuiPaper: { defaultProps: { elevation: 0 }, styleOverrides: { root: { border: '1px solid #e3e7e7' } } },
    MuiButton: { defaultProps: { disableElevation: true }, styleOverrides: { root: { textTransform: 'none', fontWeight: 600 } } },
    MuiChip: { styleOverrides: { root: { fontWeight: 500 } } },
    MuiToggleButton: { styleOverrides: { root: { textTransform: 'none' } } },
  },
})

const WIDTH = 232

const MAIN_NAV = [
  { to: '/', key: 'nav_home', icon: <HomeIcon /> },
  { to: '/contracts', key: 'nav_contracts', icon: <DescriptionIcon /> },
  { to: '/clauses', key: 'nav_clauses', icon: <GridOnIcon /> },
  { to: '/checks', key: 'nav_checks', icon: <FactCheckIcon /> },
  { to: '/approvals', key: 'nav_approvals', icon: <HowToRegIcon /> },
  { to: '/ask', key: 'nav_ask', icon: <QuestionAnswerIcon /> },
] as const

const TECH_NAV = [
  { to: '/tech/quality', key: 'nav_quality', icon: <AssessmentIcon /> },
  { to: '/tech/models', key: 'nav_models', icon: <MemoryIcon /> },
] as const

function Shell() {
  const t = useT(COMMON)
  const { lang, setLang, tech, setTech } = useSettings()
  const { data: config } = usePolling(api.config, 0, () => false)
  const { data: pending } = usePolling(() => api.findings('pending'), 15000, () => true)
  const [techOpen, setTechOpen] = useState(false)

  return (
    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex' }}>
      <AppBar position="fixed" color="inherit" sx={{ zIndex: (th) => th.zIndex.drawer + 1, borderBottom: '1px solid #e3e7e7' }}>
        <Toolbar>
          <GavelIcon color="primary" sx={{ mr: 1.5 }} />
          <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            Contract Intelligence
          </Typography>
          {config && (
            <Tooltip title={config.llm_enabled ? '' : t('ai_off_hint')}>
              <Chip size="small" color={config.llm_enabled ? 'success' : 'warning'} variant="outlined" label={config.llm_enabled ? t('ai_on') : t('ai_off')} sx={{ mr: 2 }} />
            </Tooltip>
          )}
          <Tooltip title={t('lang_hint')}>
            <ToggleButtonGroup size="small" exclusive value={lang} onChange={(_, v: Lang | null) => v && setLang(v)} aria-label="Sprache / Language">
              <ToggleButton value="de">DE</ToggleButton>
              <ToggleButton value="en">EN</ToggleButton>
            </ToggleButtonGroup>
          </Tooltip>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>
      <Drawer variant="permanent" sx={{ width: WIDTH, [`& .MuiDrawer-paper`]: { width: WIDTH, boxSizing: 'border-box' } }}>
        <Toolbar />
        <List sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
          {MAIN_NAV.map((n) => (
            <ListItemButton key={n.to} component={NavLink} to={n.to} end={n.to === '/'} sx={{ '&.active': { bgcolor: 'action.selected', color: 'primary.main' } }}>
              <ListItemIcon sx={{ minWidth: 40, color: 'inherit' }}>
                {n.key === 'nav_approvals' ? (
                  <Badge badgeContent={pending?.length ?? 0} color="warning">
                    {n.icon}
                  </Badge>
                ) : (
                  n.icon
                )}
              </ListItemIcon>
              <ListItemText primary={t(n.key)} />
            </ListItemButton>
          ))}
        </List>
        <List dense sx={{ pb: 1 }}>
          <ListItemButton onClick={() => setTechOpen(!techOpen)} sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
            <ListItemText primary={t('nav_tech')} slotProps={{ primary: { variant: 'caption', sx: { textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 0.6 } } }} />
            {techOpen ? <ExpandLessIcon fontSize="small" /> : <ExpandMoreIcon fontSize="small" />}
          </ListItemButton>
          <Collapse in={techOpen}>
            {TECH_NAV.map((n) => (
              <ListItemButton key={n.to} component={NavLink} to={n.to} sx={{ pl: 3, color: 'text.secondary', '&.active': { color: 'primary.main' } }}>
                <ListItemIcon sx={{ minWidth: 32, color: 'inherit' }}>{n.icon}</ListItemIcon>
                <ListItemText primary={t(n.key)} slotProps={{ primary: { variant: 'body2' } }} />
              </ListItemButton>
            ))}
          </Collapse>
          <Box sx={{ px: 2, pt: 1 }}>
            <FormControlLabel
              control={<Switch size="small" checked={tech} onChange={(e) => setTech(e.target.checked)} />}
              label={<Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">{t('tech_switch')}</Typography>}
            />
          </Box>
        </List>
      </Drawer>
      <Box component="main" sx={{ flexGrow: 1, p: 3, minWidth: 0 }}>
        <Toolbar />
        <Routes>
          <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
          <Route path="/contracts" element={<Contracts />} />
          <Route path="/clauses" element={<Clauses />} />
          <Route path="/checks" element={<Checks />} />
          <Route path="/checks/:id" element={<Checks />} />
          <Route path="/approvals" element={<Approvals />} />
          <Route path="/ask" element={<Ask />} />
          <Route path="/tech/quality" element={<Quality />} />
          <Route path="/tech/models" element={<Models />} />
          <Route path="/coverage" element={<Navigate to="/clauses" replace />} />
          <Route path="/audits" element={<Navigate to="/checks" replace />} />
          <Route path="/review" element={<Navigate to="/approvals" replace />} />
          <Route path="/eval" element={<Navigate to="/tech/quality" replace />} />
          <Route path="/models" element={<Navigate to="/tech/models" replace />} />
        </Routes>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  )
}

export default function App() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider theme={theme}>
      <CssBaseline />
      <SettingsProvider>
        <ToastProvider>
          <BrowserRouter>
            <Shell />
          </BrowserRouter>
        </ToastProvider>
      </SettingsProvider>
    </ThemeProvider>
  )
}

import GavelIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Gavel'
import { api } from './api'
import { SettingsProvider, useSettings, useT, type Lang } from './i18n'
import { ToastProvider, usePolling } from './components/ui'
import { COMMON } from './vocab'
import Home from './pages/Home'
import Contracts from './pages/Contracts'
import Clauses from './pages/Clauses'
import Checks from './pages/Checks'
import Approvals from './pages/Approvals'
import Ask from './pages/Ask'
import Quality from './pages/Quality'
import Models from './pages/Models'

const theme = createTheme({
  palette: {
    primary: { main: '#00695c' },
    secondary: { main: '#6a1b9a' },
    background: { default: '#f4f6f6' },
  },
  shape: { borderRadius: 10 },
  typography: { h5: { fontWeight: 600 }, h6: { fontWeight: 600 } },
  components: {
    MuiPaper: { defaultProps: { elevation: 0 }, styleOverrides: { root: { border: '1px solid #e3e7e7' } } },
    MuiButton: { defaultProps: { disableElevation: true }, styleOverrides: { root: { textTransform: 'none', fontWeight: 600 } } },
    MuiChip: { styleOverrides: { root: { fontWeight: 500 } } },
    MuiToggleButton: { styleOverrides: { root: { textTransform: 'none' } } },
  },
})

const WIDTH = 232

const MAIN_NAV = [
  { to: '/', key: 'nav_home', icon: <HomeIcon /> },
  { to: '/contracts', key: 'nav_contracts', icon: <DescriptionIcon /> },
  { to: '/clauses', key: 'nav_clauses', icon: <GridOnIcon /> },
  { to: '/checks', key: 'nav_checks', icon: <FactCheckIcon /> },
  { to: '/approvals', key: 'nav_approvals', icon: <HowToRegIcon /> },
  { to: '/ask', key: 'nav_ask', icon: <QuestionAnswerIcon /> },
] as const

const TECH_NAV = [
  { to: '/tech/quality', key: 'nav_quality', icon: <AssessmentIcon /> },
  { to: '/tech/models', key: 'nav_models', icon: <MemoryIcon /> },
] as const

function Shell() {
  const t = useT(COMMON)
  const { lang, setLang, tech, setTech } = useSettings()
  const { data: config } = usePolling(api.config, 0, () => false)
  const { data: pending } = usePolling(() => api.findings('pending'), 15000, () => true)
  const [techOpen, setTechOpen] = useState(false)

  return (
    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex' }}>
      <AppBar position="fixed" color="inherit" sx={{ zIndex: (th) => th.zIndex.drawer + 1, borderBottom: '1px solid #e3e7e7' }}>
        <Toolbar>
          <GavelIcon color="primary" sx={{ mr: 1.5 }} />
          <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
            Contract Intelligence
          </Typography>
          {config && (
            <Tooltip title={config.llm_enabled ? '' : t('ai_off_hint')}>
              <Chip size="small" color={config.llm_enabled ? 'success' : 'warning'} variant="outlined" label={config.llm_enabled ? t('ai_on') : t('ai_off')} sx={{ mr: 2 }} />
            </Tooltip>
          )}
          <Tooltip title={t('lang_hint')}>
            <ToggleButtonGroup size="small" exclusive value={lang} onChange={(_, v: Lang | null) => v && setLang(v)} aria-label="Sprache / Language">
              <ToggleButton value="de">DE</ToggleButton>
              <ToggleButton value="en">EN</ToggleButton>
            </ToggleButtonGroup>
          </Tooltip>
        </Toolbar>
      </AppBar>
      <Drawer variant="permanent" sx={{ width: WIDTH, [`& .MuiDrawer-paper`]: { width: WIDTH, boxSizing: 'border-box' } }}>
        <Toolbar />
        <List sx={{ flexGrow: 1 }}>
          {MAIN_NAV.map((n) => (
            <ListItemButton key={n.to} component={NavLink} to={n.to} end={n.to === '/'} sx={{ '&.active': { bgcolor: 'action.selected', color: 'primary.main' } }}>
              <ListItemIcon sx={{ minWidth: 40, color: 'inherit' }}>
                {n.key === 'nav_approvals' ? (
                  <Badge badgeContent={pending?.length ?? 0} color="warning">
                    {n.icon}
                  </Badge>
                ) : (
                  n.icon
                )}
              </ListItemIcon>
              <ListItemText primary={t(n.key)} />
            </ListItemButton>
          ))}
        </List>
        <List dense sx={{ pb: 1 }}>
          <ListItemButton onClick={() => setTechOpen(!techOpen)} sx={{ color: 'text.secondary' }}>
            <ListItemText primary={t('nav_tech')} slotProps={{ primary: { variant: 'caption', sx: { textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 0.6 } } }} />
            {techOpen ? <ExpandLessIcon fontSize="small" /> : <ExpandMoreIcon fontSize="small" />}
          </ListItemButton>
          <Collapse in={techOpen}>
            {TECH_NAV.map((n) => (
              <ListItemButton key={n.to} component={NavLink} to={n.to} sx={{ pl: 3, color: 'text.secondary', '&.active': { color: 'primary.main' } }}>
                <ListItemIcon sx={{ minWidth: 32, color: 'inherit' }}>{n.icon}</ListItemIcon>
                <ListItemText primary={t(n.key)} slotProps={{ primary: { variant: 'body2' } }} />
              </ListItemButton>
            ))}
          </Collapse>
          <Box sx={{ px: 2, pt: 1 }}>
            <FormControlLabel
              control={<Switch size="small" checked={tech} onChange={(e) => setTech(e.target.checked)} />}
              label={<Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">{t('tech_switch')}</Typography>}
            />
          </Box>
        </List>
      </Drawer>
      <Box component="main" sx={{ flexGrow: 1, p: 3, minWidth: 0 }}>
        <Toolbar />
        <Routes>
          <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
          <Route path="/contracts" element={<Contracts />} />
          <Route path="/clauses" element={<Clauses />} />
          <Route path="/checks" element={<Checks />} />
          <Route path="/checks/:id" element={<Checks />} />
          <Route path="/approvals" element={<Approvals />} />
          <Route path="/ask" element={<Ask />} />
          <Route path="/tech/quality" element={<Quality />} />
          <Route path="/tech/models" element={<Models />} />
          <Route path="/coverage" element={<Navigate to="/clauses" replace />} />
          <Route path="/audits" element={<Navigate to="/checks" replace />} />
          <Route path="/review" element={<Navigate to="/approvals" replace />} />
          <Route path="/eval" element={<Navigate to="/tech/quality" replace />} />
          <Route path="/models" element={<Navigate to="/tech/models" replace />} />
        </Routes>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  )
}

export default function App() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider theme={theme}>
      <CssBaseline />
      <SettingsProvider>
        <ToastProvider>
          <BrowserRouter>
            <Shell />
          </BrowserRouter>
        </ToastProvider>
      </SettingsProvider>
    </ThemeProvider>
  )
}

}

# UI spec — Contract Intelligence for a German-speaking legal team

Audience: lawyers and paralegals, mostly German-speaking, not engineers. German is the default; English is one
click away. The tool must feel simple and pleasant. All technical substance is kept, but one layer down: small
print, a collapsed "Details" disclosure, or the global switch **Technische Details anzeigen** (off by default).

This document is the contract for every page. The foundation it relies on already exists — reuse it, do not
re-implement it:

| File | Provides |
| --- | --- |
| `web/src/i18n.tsx` | `SettingsProvider`, `useSettings()` → `{ lang, setLang, tech, setTech }`, `useT(DICT)` → `t('key', {vars})`, `useLabel(MAP)` → `(value) => string` |
| `web/src/vocab.ts` | Every DE/EN word for backend enums (`AUDIT_KINDS`, `AUDIT_QUESTIONS`, `VERDICTS`, `VERDICT_HELP`, `REVIEW_STATUS`, `DOC_STATUS`, `AUDIT_STATUS`, `CLAUSE_TYPES`, `CLAUSE_SHORT`, `CONTRACT_TYPES`, `CONTRACT_TYPE_KEYS`, `INPUT_TYPES`, `LANGUAGES`, `PAGE_METHODS`, `LEGIBILITY`, `RELIABILITY`, `CLAUSE_METHODS`, `ENTITY_KINDS`, `ENTITY_METHODS`, `LOG_ACTIONS`, `ROUTING_TASKS`, `THINKING`, `modelTier()`) and `COMMON` UI strings |
| `web/src/components/tech.tsx` | `<Tech>` (renders children only when the switch is on), `<Small>` (grey 11.5px print), `<Details label?>` (collapsed disclosure) |
| `web/src/components/ui.tsx` | `usePolling`, `useToast`/`ToastProvider`, `legibility(doc)`, `reliability(v)`, `useFindingSentence()`, `VerdictChip`, `ReviewChip`, `AuditKindChip`, `LegibilityChip`, `Reliability`, `Quote`, `EvidenceList`, `HowFound`, `DecisionDialog`, `EmptyState` |
| `web/src/App.tsx` | Shell: app bar (AI status chip, DE|EN toggle), nav with Freigabe badge, collapsed "Technik" group, the switch. Routes below. |
| `web/src/api.ts` | The fixed backend contract. `createAudit(kind, params, language)` and `chat(question, language)` take the UI language. |

## Conventions (every page)

* **Page-local dictionary**: each page defines `const T = { key: { de, en } }` at the top and uses `const t = useT(T)`. Every visible string goes through `t()` or a vocab map. No hardcoded German or English in JSX. Both languages complete.
* **Register**: German in Sie-Form, calm, precise, first-person plural for progress ("Wir lesen gerade 3 von 14 Verträgen …"). No exclamation marks, no emojis, no jokes in verdicts. Buttons carry verbs (Prüfen, Freigeben, Ablehnen, Ablegen). "Bestätigt/bestätigen" belongs to the machine verdict — never use it for a human action.
* **Words**: Fund (finding), Vertrag, Klausel, Regelung (passage), Prüfung (check), Freigabe (approval), Beleg (evidence), Vertragsablage (contract storage), Protokoll (activity log), Namensregister, Klausel-Übersicht, Verlässlichkeit (confidence), Lesbarkeit (legibility), Prüfsumme (checksum), KI-Gegenprüfung (verifier). English equivalents are in `vocab.ts`.

* **Empty states** use `EmptyState` with a next step. **Progress** is honest: determinate where counts exist (documents ready / total), indeterminate for a running check ("… dauert meist unter einer Minute").
* **MUI 9**: system props (`alignItems`, `flexWrap`, `display`, `fontWeight`, …) are NOT accepted on `Stack`/`Typography` — put them in `sx`. `Box` is fine. Use `Stack`, `Box` with CSS grid, `Paper`, `Table`, `Chip`, `Tabs`, `Dialog`, `ToggleButtonGroup`, `LinearProgress`, `Alert`, `Tooltip`, `Snackbar` via `useToast`. Icons from `@mui/icons-material/<Name>`.

* **Titles**: `doc.title || doc.filename`. The backend already replaces garbled OCR titles with the filename stem.
* **Contract-set counts for sentences**: "in scope" = documents with `status === 'ready'` and, if a contract type filter is set, matching `contract_type`.
* Actor is hard-coded `legal.reviewer` (no auth yet) — copy says "unter dem Kürzel legal.reviewer", never "mit Ihrem Namen".

| Route | File | DE / EN nav |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/` | `pages/Home.tsx` | Start / Home |
| `/contracts` | `pages/Contracts.tsx` | Verträge / Contracts |
| `/clauses` | `pages/Clauses.tsx` | Klauseln / Clauses |
| `/checks`, `/checks/:id` | `pages/Checks.tsx` | Prüfungen / Checks |
| `/approvals` | `pages/Approvals.tsx` | Freigabe / Approvals |
| `/ask` | `pages/Ask.tsx` | Fragen / Ask |
| `/tech/quality` | `pages/Quality.tsx` | Qualitätsmessung / Quality measurement (Technik group) |
| `/tech/models` | `pages/Models.tsx` | Modelle / Models (Technik group) |

### Home — "Was möchten Sie wissen?" / "What would you like to know?"
* Greeting by time of day (Guten Morgen / Guten Tag / Guten Abend; Good morning / afternoon / evening) and the headline.
* Three question cards, one per audit kind (`AUDIT_QUESTIONS`), each with exactly the one input it needs and a **Prüfen** button: (1) clause select (`CLAUSE_TYPES`, the 12 taxonomy keys from `api.config().taxonomy`; show "(n fehlen)" counts from `api.coverage()` next to each name; remember the last choice in localStorage); (2) passage text field (grows on focus; helper "Der Wortlaut muss nicht exakt stimmen – sinngemäß reicht."); (3) old-name card with the registry hint "arvato Financial Solutions, Arvato Payment Solutions GmbH, AFS → Riverty GmbH" and an optional "Anderer Name" field behind a small link. Optional Vertragsart select applies to all three. Prüfen → `api.createAudit(kind, params, lang)` → `navigate('/checks/' + id)`.
* Strip below: left "Wartet auf Ihre Freigabe" with the pending count (`api.findings('pending')`) and button "Zur Freigabe" (or "Nichts wartet auf Sie." with a check icon); right "Ihr Vertragsbestand": "14 Verträge · 13 gut lesbar · 1 nicht lesbar" (from `legibility`), a `LinearProgress` with "Wir lesen gerade 3 von 14 Verträgen …" while any document is queued/processing (poll every 2 s while so), and a button "Verträge hinzufügen" → `/contracts`.
* "Letzte Prüfungen": the three most recent audits as sentences (kind · scope · counts from `summary.findings` keyed by verdict) with `AUDIT_STATUS` chip, each linking to `/checks/:id`.
* Empty state (no documents): question cards disabled with hint "Zuerst Verträge hinzufügen"; centred card "Noch keine Verträge. Laden Sie PDFs oder Fotos hoch – oder starten Sie mit den 14 Beispielverträgen." with buttons "Verträge hochladen" (→ `/contracts`) and "Beispielverträge laden" (`api.ingestSamples()` then poll).
* `<Tech>`: footer line "KI-Gegenprüfung: verbunden (model id)" / "nicht verbunden".

### Contracts — Verträge / Contracts
* Toolbar: primary "Verträge hochladen (PDF, JPG, PNG)" (hidden multi-file input) and secondary "Beispielverträge laden (14 Verträge, darunter Scans und eine Handschrift)". A drop zone appears while dragging files over the page.
* While any document is queued/processing: banner with determinate `LinearProgress` "Wir lesen gerade x von y Verträgen …"; on completion toast "Alle 14 Verträge sind bereit." with action "Jetzt prüfen" → `/`.
* Table: Vertrag (title, filename in `<Small>`) · Vertragsart (`CONTRACT_TYPES`) · Sprache (`LANGUAGES`) · Form (`INPUT_TYPES`, tooltip for mixed_pdf "z. B. digitaler Vertrag mit eingescannter Unterschriftenseite") · Lesbarkeit (`LegibilityChip`, tooltip "Nicht lesbar = wird in Prüfungen als ungeprüft ausgewiesen") · a shield icon with tooltip `COMMON.suspicious` when `injection_suspected` · Status (`DOC_STATUS`; failed → raw error under `<Details>`). Within `<Tech>` add the per-page extraction chips (`PAGE_METHODS` + %), clause/entity counts.
* Row click → dialog "Vertrag ansehen": title, contract type, language, pages, `<Small>` "Prüfsumme 6b52e1ca" with tooltip `checksum_hint` (full hash inside `<Tech>`). Injection alert in plain words (`COMMON.suspicious_help`); the matched text under `<Details>`. Tabs: **Klauseln** (Nr, Überschrift, Art via `CLAUSE_TYPES`, Seite; click a row to expand the clause text; `<Tech>`: `Reliability` % and `CLAUSE_METHODS` + rule/llm labels), **Genannte Unternehmen** (Name, Rolle via `ENTITY_KINDS` — old name red, current green, others grey — badge "nur historischer Verweis" when `historical`, Seite, Kontext in `<Small>`; `<Tech>`: `ENTITY_METHODS` + match %), **Seitentext** (per page "Seite n" header + a legibility word; `<Tech>`: page method chip + %; text in a pre-wrap box). Reads `?open=<id>&page=<n>` from the URL to open directly on Seitentext scrolled to that page.
* Empty state as on Home.

### Clauses — Klausel-Übersicht / Clause overview
* Subtitle "Welcher Vertrag enthält welche Klausel?" and one sentence: "Die Übersicht entsteht beim Einlesen jedes Vertrags. Ein Strich heißt: Wir haben keine solche Klausel gefunden."
* Filter: Vertragsart select (`CONTRACT_TYPE_KEYS` + all). Switch "Nur Lücken zeigen" (show only rows with at least one gap).
* Matrix: sticky first column (title; `<Small>` type · language), 12 columns headed by `CLAUSE_SHORT` (full name in tooltip) with "fehlt in n" under each header and a small button/menu "Diese Klausel prüfen" → `api.createAudit('missing_clause', {clause_type, contract_type?}, lang)` → navigate to `/checks/:id`. Cells: green check (`confidence ≥ 0.8`), amber ring/"?" (0.5–0.8, tooltip "vorhanden, unsicher"), grey dash (not found — neutral, NOT red: an NDA legitimately lacks most clauses). Tooltip: "Haftungsbegrenzung · „Limitation of Liability“ · Seite 2"; `<Tech>` adds "% via method" and opacity shading. Cell click → deep link to the contract (Seitentext at that page). Legend row under the table.
* Empty state: "Die Übersicht füllt sich, sobald Verträge gelesen sind."

### Checks — Prüfungen / Checks (`/checks` and `/checks/:id`)
* Left column, card "Neue Prüfung": `ToggleButtonGroup` with the three questions (`AUDIT_QUESTIONS`, icons), then only the one field the question needs (clause select with "(n fehlen)" from coverage / passage textarea with the helper / optional old-name field with the registry helper "Leer lassen = alle bekannten alten Namen: …"), optional Vertragsart select, primary button **Prüfung starten**. Location state or `?kind=&clause_type=` may preselect. Below: "Bisherige Prüfungen" list as sentences ("Fehlende Klausel: Haftungsbegrenzung · Händlerverträge", "Alter Firmenname · alle Vertragsarten") with date and `AUDIT_STATUS` chip; selecting navigates to `/checks/:id`. "Erneut prüfen" on a past check refills the form.
* Right column (selected check): running → indeterminate bar "Wir lesen n Verträge … das dauert meist unter einer Minute." (poll 1.5 s). Done → **one summary sentence** built per kind from `summary` (`scope`, `present`, `historical_only`, `unreadable`) and `summary.findings` (counts by verdict: confirmed, unverified, dismissed, unreadable), e.g. "14 Verträge geprüft: 8 nennen noch den alten Firmennamen, 4 sind unauffällig, 1 nennt den alten Namen nur als historischen Verweis, 1 konnte nicht gelesen werden und gilt nicht als geprüft." Then four tiles: auffällig (confirmed + unverified) · unauffällig (present + historical_only + dismissed) · unklar (uncertain) · nicht lesbar; and a chip `verified_yes`/`verified_no` (`<Tech>` adds the verifier model). Row expand: `EvidenceList`, "Vertrag öffnen" deep link, `Reliability` (`unreadable` when verdict is unreadable), reasoning block labelled `COMMON.reasoning` only when `reasoning` is non-empty, `HowFound`, and — for pending findings — buttons Freigeben / Ablehnen via `DecisionDialog` (refresh after). * Header "n Funde warten auf Ihre Entscheidung." and one line "Nichts verlässt das System ohne Ihre Entscheidung. Jede Entscheidung wird unter dem Kürzel legal.reviewer mit Zeitpunkt und Dokument-Prüfsumme protokolliert."
* Tabs: **Offen (n)** · **Entschieden (n)** · **Protokoll**.

* Entschieden: table Vertrag · Fund · Entscheidung (`ReviewChip` + "legal.reviewer · date time") · Anmerkung · Vertragsablage: button "In der Vertragsablage ablegen" (tooltip `file_hint`) for approved without `storage_ref`, else the `ReviewChip` filed state. Intro "Einträge können nachträglich nicht geändert oder gelöscht werden."

### Ask — Fragen / Ask
* Headline "Fragen Sie Ihre Verträge" / "Ask your contracts". One large field, placeholder "Zum Beispiel: Welche Kündigungsfrist gilt im Inkassovertrag mit Rheinland Energie?", button **Fragen**, Enter sends. Example chips in the UI language (DE: "Welcher Gerichtsstand gilt im Vertrag mit Nordlicht Möbelhaus?", "Welche Kündigungsfrist gilt im Inkassovertrag mit Rheinland Energie?", "Welche Haftungsgrenze gilt im Händlervertrag mit Lumen Retail?"; EN: the equivalents). * Intro: "Das Beispielpaket hat eine Musterlösung: Für jeden Vertrag ist bekannt, welche Klauseln er enthält und wo noch ein alter Name steht. Hier sehen Sie, wie gut jede Stufe trifft." Button **Messung starten** (`api.runEval()`), empty state "Noch keine Messung. Starten Sie eine – sie dauert etwa eine halbe Minute."
* Result shape (from the backend): `{ documents, unreadable: string[], llm_enabled, coverage_matrix: {metrics:{tp,fp,fn,precision,recall,f1}, errors:[{key,error}]}, rename_registry: {same}, extraction: {[input_type]: {pages, methods:{[m]:n}, confidence}}, audits: [{audit_id, kind, params, verified, metrics, errors}], injection: [{id, expected, flagged}] }`. Error keys look like `C07:data_protection`, `error` is `false_positive`/`false_negative`.
* Two cards (Klausel-Übersicht, Namensregister), each with two sentences: "Von den gemeldeten fehlenden Klauseln waren 85 % richtig (7 Fehlalarme)." and "Von den tatsächlich fehlenden Klauseln wurden 100 % gefunden (0 übersehen)." Metrics labelled "Treffergenauigkeit (Precision)" / "Vollständigkeit (Recall)"; F1 and TP/FP/FN only in `<Tech>`. Errors as "C07 · Datenschutz · Fehlalarm" (raw key in `<Tech>`).
* Table "Abgeschlossene Prüfungen" (plain titles, Gegengeprüft ja/nein, the two percentages). Collapsed sections "Lesbarkeit nach Quelle" (`INPUT_TYPES`, pages, average as word + %; `<Tech>`: method counts) and "Erkennung verdächtiger Texte" (id · erwartet/erkannt · richtig/falsch). Line "C14 wurde als nicht lesbar an Sie weitergegeben und zählt nicht als geprüft." when `unreadable` is non-empty.

* Status alert: "KI-Gegenprüfung aktiv – alle Stufen laufen." (success) or "Keine KI verbunden – Regelprüfung, Namensregister, Texterkennung und Suche laufen; Funde werden als „nicht gegengeprüft“ gekennzeichnet. Handschrift kann nicht gelesen werden." (warning). Intro: "Der Denkaufwand folgt der Aufgabe: Routinearbeit läuft auf einem schnellen Modell, das große Modell ist für Handschrift und für die Gegenprüfung reserviert."
* Table: Aufgabe (`ROUTING_TASKS`) · Modell (`modelTier(id)` word; the raw id in `<Tech>` monospace) · Denkaufwand (`THINKING` chips) · Zweck (German/English text keyed by task, written in the page dictionary; the API's English `purpose` only in `<Tech>`). Last row: embeddings (`config.embedding.model`, dim in `<Tech>`).

# UI spec — Contract Intelligence for a German-speaking legal team

Audience: lawyers and paralegals, mostly German-speaking, not engineers. German is the default; English is one
click away. The tool must feel simple and pleasant. All technical substance is kept, but one layer down: small
print, a collapsed "Details" disclosure, or the global switch **Technische Details anzeigen** (off by default).

This document is the contract for every page. The foundation it relies on already exists — reuse it, do not
re-implement it:

| File | Provides |
| --- | --- |
| `web/src/i18n.tsx` | `SettingsProvider`, `useSettings()` → `{ lang, setLang, tech, setTech }`, `useT(DICT)` → `t('key', {vars})`, `useLabel(MAP)` → `(value) => string` |
| `web/src/vocab.ts` | Every DE/EN word for backend enums (`AUDIT_KINDS`, `AUDIT_QUESTIONS`, `VERDICTS`, `VERDICT_HELP`, `REVIEW_STATUS`, `DOC_STATUS`, `AUDIT_STATUS`, `CLAUSE_TYPES`, `CLAUSE_SHORT`, `CONTRACT_TYPES`, `CONTRACT_TYPE_KEYS`, `INPUT_TYPES`, `LANGUAGES`, `PAGE_METHODS`, `LEGIBILITY`, `RELIABILITY`, `CLAUSE_METHODS`, `ENTITY_KINDS`, `ENTITY_METHODS`, `LOG_ACTIONS`, `ROUTING_TASKS`, `THINKING`, `modelTier()`) and `COMMON` UI strings |
| `web/src/components/tech.tsx` | `<Tech>` (renders children only when the switch is on), `<Small>` (grey 11.5px print), `<Details label?>` (collapsed disclosure) |
| `web/src/components/ui.tsx` | `usePolling`, `useToast`/`ToastProvider`, `legibility(doc)`, `reliability(v)`, `useFindingSentence()`, `VerdictChip`, `ReviewChip`, `AuditKindChip`, `LegibilityChip`, `Reliability`, `Quote`, `EvidenceList`, `HowFound`, `DecisionDialog`, `EmptyState` |
| `web/src/App.tsx` | Shell: app bar (AI status chip, DE|EN toggle), nav with Freigabe badge, collapsed "Technik" group, the switch. Routes below. |
| `web/src/api.ts` | The fixed backend contract. `createAudit(kind, params, language)` and `chat(question, language)` take the UI language. |

## Conventions (every page)

* **Page-local dictionary**: each page defines `const T = { key: { de, en } }` at the top and uses `const t = useT(T)`. Every visible string goes through `t()` or a vocab map. No hardcoded German or English in JSX. Both languages complete.
* **Register**: German in Sie-Form, calm, precise, first-person plural for progress ("Wir lesen gerade 3 von 14 Verträgen …"). No exclamation marks, no emojis, no jokes in verdicts. Buttons carry verbs (Prüfen, Freigeben, Ablehnen, Ablegen). "Bestätigt/bestätigen" belongs to the machine verdict — never use it for a human action.
* **Words**: Fund (finding), Vertrag, Klausel, Regelung (passage), Prüfung (check), Freigabe (approval), Beleg (evidence), Vertragsablage (contract storage), Protokoll (activity log), Namensregister, Klausel-Übersicht, Verlässlichkeit (confidence), Lesbarkeit (legibility), Prüfsumme (checksum), KI-Gegenprüfung (verifier). * **Technical layer**: percentages, method traces, model IDs, OCR methods, SHA-256, raw enum keys, retrieval scores, thresholds → only inside `<Tech>` (switch on) or `<Details>`; when shown, use `<Small>`. 26	/** Poll `fn` every `ms` while `active`; always fetch once on mount. `refresh()` refetches now. */
27	export function usePolling<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, ms: number, active: (data: T | null) => boolean) {
28	  const [data, setData] = useState<T | null>(null)
29	  const [error, setError] = useState('')
30	  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0)
31	  useEffect(() => {
32	    let cancelled = false
33	    fn()
34	      .then((d) => !cancelled && (setData(d), setError('')))
35	      .catch((e) => !cancelled && setError(String(e)))
36	    return () => {
37	      cancelled = true
38	    }
39	  }, [tick]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
40	  useEffect(() => {
41	    if (!active(data)) return
42	    const id = setTimeout(() => setTick((t) => t + 1), ms)
43	    return () => clearTimeout(id)
44	  }, [data, ms, active])
45	  return { data, error, refresh: () => setTick((t) => t + 1) }
46	}

54	  return (

export const meta = {
  name: 'legal-ui-implement',
  description: 'Rebuild the 8 UI pages for the German-speaking legal team against docs/ui-spec.md, review, fix, e2e',
  phases: [
    { title: 'Pages', detail: 'one agent per page, disjoint files' },
    { title: 'Compile', detail: 'tsc + vite build, cross-file fixes' },
    { title: 'Review', detail: 'German legal register + spec/engineering conformance' },
    { title: 'Fix', detail: 'per-file fixers for confirmed findings' },
    { title: 'E2E', detail: 'rewrite Playwright smoke suite, run against :5174' },
  ],
}

const REPO = '/Users/gaurav/Downloads/riverty_challenge'
const WEB = `${REPO}/web`
const BASE = `
Project: ${WEB} (React 19 + TypeScript strict + MUI 9 + Vite 8 + react-router 7). Backend API is running and fixed.
Read FIRST, completely: ${REPO}/docs/ui-spec.md (conventions + page sections), ${WEB}/src/i18n.tsx, ${WEB}/src/vocab.ts,
${WEB}/src/components/tech.tsx, ${WEB}/src/components/ui.tsx, ${WEB}/src/api.ts, ${WEB}/src/App.tsx.
Rules: reuse the foundation (never re-implement i18n, chips, dialog, toasts); every visible string through a page-local
dictionary "const T = { key: { de, en } }" + useT(T) or the vocab maps; German default in Sie-Form, calm, no exclamation
marks/emojis; technical numbers/IDs/method strings only inside <Tech> or <Details> using <Small>; MUI 9 has no system
props on Stack/Typography (use sx); TypeScript strict with noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters/verbatimModuleSyntax
(import { type X }). The live API (offline mode, 14 sample contracts ingested, some audits done) is at
http://127.0.0.1:8000 — you may curl it to see real response shapes (e.g. curl -s localhost:8000/api/audits/4).`

const PAGES = [
  { file: 'Home.tsx', section: 'Home — "Was möchten Sie wissen?"' },
  { file: 'Contracts.tsx', section: 'Contracts — Verträge' },
  { file: 'Clauses.tsx', section: 'Clauses — Klausel-Übersicht' },
  { file: 'Checks.tsx', section: 'Checks — Prüfungen (/checks and /checks/:id)' },
  { file: 'Approvals.tsx', section: 'Approvals — Freigabe' },
  { file: 'Ask.tsx', section: 'Ask — Fragen' },
  { file: 'Quality.tsx', section: 'Quality — Qualitätsmessung' },
  { file: 'Models.tsx', section: 'Models — Modelle' },
]

const PAGE_REPORT = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    file: { type: 'string' },
    done: { type: 'boolean' },
    summary: { type: 'string' },
    foundation_requests: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'Changes you believe are needed in shared files (you did NOT make them)' },
    notes: { type: 'string' },
  },
  required: ['file', 'done', 'summary', 'foundation_requests', 'notes'],
}

phase('Pages')
const pageReports = (await parallel(PAGES.map((p) => () =>
  agent(`${BASE}

YOUR TASK: write ${WEB}/src/pages/${p.file} implementing the spec section "${p.section}" exactly and completely (every
bullet). Default-export the page component. Do not create or modify any other file; if a shared change seems needed,
do not make it — list it in foundation_requests and work around it locally.
Verify: from ${WEB} run "npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json" and fix every error that mentions your file. Errors
mentioning OTHER files under src/pages are expected while sibling pages are being written in parallel — ignore them.
Return the structured report only.`, { label: `page:${p.file}`, phase: 'Pages', schema: PAGE_REPORT })
))).filter(Boolean)
log(`pages written: ${pageReports.filter((r) => r.done).map((r) => r.file).join(', ')}`)
const foundationRequests = pageReports.flatMap((r) => r.foundation_requests.map((x) => `${r.file}: ${x}`))

phase('Compile')
const compile = await agent(`${BASE}

All eight pages under ${WEB}/src/pages now exist. From ${WEB} run "npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json" and then
"npm run build". Fix every remaining error with the smallest possible edit, in whichever file it lives (pages or, only

attachment.snippet:
1	# Contract Intelligence — Riverty RAG case study
2	
3	A tool for the legal team's two recurring questions — **which contracts do *not* contain passage X?** and
4	**which contracts still carry a superseded company name?** — over PDFs, scans and handwritten JPEGs.
5	
6	The pitch in one sentence: *retrieval is good at finding what is there and bad at proving what is not, so the
7	system decomposes every contract at ingest time into typed clauses and resolved entities, answers absence
8	questions from that structure, lets a strong model verify every finding against the full contract, and never
9	acts without a person.*
10	
11	## What is different about it
12	
13	| Concern | Answer built in |
14	| --- | --- |
15	| "Why not just ask an LLM?" | Absence is a lookup in the **clause-coverage matrix**, not an inference. The LLM refines labels and verifies; it is never the only source of truth. |
16	| "How confident is it?" | Every finding carries a confidence, the **evidence quote with page**, and the **method trace** (rule → embedding → verifier) that produced it. |
17	| "Could it be wrong?" | Yes — so the **verifier reads the whole contract** (not retrieved chunks) for every non-certain claim, low-OCR pages become an explicit `unreadable` verdict instead of a silent pass, and a **ground-truth eval** puts precision/recall on screen per layer. |
18	| "These documents are sensitive." | Nothing changes state without **human approval**; pushes to the contract storage are **idempotent**; every action lands in an **append-only audit log** keyed by document SHA-256. |
19	| "Is it safe against manipulated documents?" | Contract text is **untrusted input**: hidden instructions are screened at ingest and every model prompt is told to treat document text as data. Fixture C13 carries a hidden injection. |
20	| "What about scans and handwriting?" | Per-page routing: text layer → direct; no text layer → Tesseract with a confidence gate; low confidence → **vision model**; OCR noise → **fuzzy entity matching** with the match ratio recorded. |
21	| "Which model, and why?" | **Routing by task**: cheap low-thinking Flash for labelling, high-thinking Pro only for handwriting and verification, Flash-Lite for screening. Offline, the deterministic core still runs end to end. |
22	
23	## The front-end is for lawyers, not engineers
24	
25	German by default, English one click away (DE | EN in the app bar; the choice is also sent to the models, so the
26	verifier's reasoning and answers come back in that language). The start page asks the three questions directly:
27	*Welchen Verträgen fehlt eine Klausel? · Welche Verträge enthalten eine bestimmte Regelung nicht? · Wo steht noch ein
28	alter Firmenname?* Verdicts name their author — **KI-bestätigt / Nicht gegengeprüft / Entkräftet / Nicht lesbar** —
29	so a machine verdict can never be mistaken for human sign-off; the check icon is reserved for people. Confidence is a
30	word, evidence is a quote with a page, and every finding has a collapsed *„So kam der Fund zustande“*. Percentages,
31	method traces, model IDs, OCR methods and checksums stay available behind the switch **Technische Details anzeigen**
32	(off by default) and the low-key *Technik* group in the navigation. The full page contract is in `docs/ui-spec.md`.
33	
34	## Architecture
35	
36	```mermaid
37	flowchart LR
38	  SP[SharePoint / upload] --> L[Loader: per-page routing]
39	  L -->|text layer| T[Text]
40	  L -->|no text layer| O[Tesseract]
41	  O -->|conf < 80%| V[Gemini Pro vision]
42	  T & O & V --> S[Segment into clauses]
43	  S --> C[Classify: rules + Flash]
44	  S --> E[Entities: registry + fuzzy + Flash]
45	  S --> M[Embed → pgvector + tsvector]
46	  C & E & M --> DB[(PostgreSQL / pgvector)]
47	  DB --> A[Audit graph: plan → deterministic → verify → report]
48	  A --> R[Review queue → approve → push]
49	  R --> CS[Contract storage API]
50	  DB --> Q[Ask: hybrid retrieval → cited answer]
51	```
52	
53	* `api/app/ingest/` — loader, OCR, segmentation, classification, entities, embeddings, injection screen, pipeline
54	* `api/app/audits/graph.py` — the LangGraph audit; `verify.py` — the full-contract verifier
55	* `api/app/retrieval.py` — pgvector + full-text (English + German stemming) fused with RRF
56	* `api/app/chat.py` — retrieve → cited answer graph; `evaluation.py` — scoring against `data/ground_truth.json`
57	* `api/app/llm.py` — the model routing table; `api/app/routers.py` — REST API incl. the mock contract storage
58	* `web/` — React 19 + TypeScript + MUI 9, German/English (`src/vocab.ts`, `src/i18n.tsx`); `web/e2e/` — Playwright smoke suite
59	* `data/generate.py` — builds the corpus: every input type, with known ground truth
60	* `infra/terraform/` — production shape on Azure (documentation, not applied)
61	
62	## Sample corpus (generated, ground truth known)
63	
64	14 contracts: born-digital PDFs in English and German, a clean scan and a low-quality skewed scan, a handwritten
65	1996 agreement (JPEG), a photographed typed amendment (JPEG), a digital contract whose **scanned signature page**
66	still names the old entity, one that already says "Riverty (formerly Arvato Payment Solutions)", one with the
67	unrelated **Arvato Systems** as counterparty, and one with a hidden prompt-injection.
68	
69	## Run it
70	
71	```bash
72	cp .env.example .env            # add GEMINI_API_KEY for the full pipeline; leave empty for offline mode
73	docker compose up --build       # web on http://localhost:5173, api on http://localhost:8000/docs
74	```
75	
76	Then *Documents → Ingest sample set*, *Audits → Run audit*, *Review*, *Evaluation → Run evaluation*.
77	
78	Local development:
79	
80	```bash
81	docker compose up -d db
82	cd api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload      # http://localhost:8000
83	cd web && npm install && npm run dev               # http://localhost:5173 (proxies /api)
84	```
85	
86	## Tests
87	
88	```bash
89	cd api && uv run pytest            # 22 offline unit tests + 8 end-to-end against pgvector (skips without db)
90	cd web && npx playwright test      # 9 browser smoke tests against the running stack (BASE_URL overrides :5173)
91	```
92	
93	Regenerate the corpus with `cd api && uv run python ../data/generate.py`.

content.text:
The UI rebuild is done, committed (`48e4eb9` + two README commits), and the containerized stack at **http://localhost:5173** now serves it.

## What changed

**Approach.** I ran a small design panel first — three proposals from different lenses (a lawyer who hates software, a flow-designer, a UX writer for trust in legal documents), scored by a German-lawyer judge and an engineer judge. They split on the winner but agreed on the synthesis: the lawyer-first *structure* with the trust-writer's *vocabulary*. That became `docs/ui-spec.md`, which eight page agents built against in parallel, followed by a compile pass, two reviewers, fixers and a rewritten Playwright suite (9/9 green).

**What the legal team sees (German default, EN one click away):**
- **Start** greets by time of day and asks the three questions directly, each with its one input and a *Prüfen* button; below: "Wartet auf Ihre Freigabe" and "Ihr Vertragsbestand · 14 Verträge · 10 gut lesbar · 3 schwer lesbar · 1 nicht lesbar".
- **Prüfungen** open with one sentence — *"14 Verträge geprüft: 8 nennen noch den alten Firmennamen, 4 sind unauffällig, 1 nennt den alten Namen nur als historischen Verweis, 1 konnte nicht gelesen werden und gilt nicht als geprüft."* — then four tiles and the table.
- **Verdicts name their author**: *KI-bestätigt / Nicht gegengeprüft / Entkräftet / Nicht lesbar*. The check icon and the word *Freigegeben* are reserved for humans; *"bestätigen"* is never used for a human action.
- Confidence is a word (*Verlässlichkeit: hoch*), evidence is a quote with page and an honest sub-label (*"Ähnlichste Stelle – ersetzt die gesuchte Klausel nicht"*), and every finding has a collapsed *"So kam der Fund zustande"*.
- **Freigabe**: *Fund 1 von 8*, approve/reject dialog stating exactly what gets logged, *In der Vertragsablage ablegen*, and the **Protokoll** as sentences grouped by day.
- Nav: Start · Verträge · Klauseln · Prüfungen · Freigabe (badge) · Fragen, plus a collapsed *Technik* group.

**Where the technical substance went:** percentages, method traces, model IDs, OCR methods, checksums, retrieval scores and raw keys sit in small grey print behind *Details* or the switch **"Technische Details anzeigen"** (off by default, persisted). The verifier's reasoning and chat answers now come back in the UI language (backend `language` param).

## Notes
- The "73 Funde" you'd see on Freigabe is accumulated test data (each test run creates another check). I'll reset the database to a clean state before presentation screenshots.
- Still waiting on your **`GEMINI_API_KEY` in `.env`** — the live-model tests are the last unverified piece before the presentation.
